guides.title: Guides
guides.description: The culture your need to know before attend socials
guides.item1_content: Maintain personal hygiene and fresh breath to ensure a quality dancing experience (we recommend using perfume, deodorant, carrying a towel, and changing clothes regularly).
guides.item2_content: Avoid leading in a way that could cause injury to your dance partner.
guides.item3_content: Maintain good spatial awareness and avoid excessive pushing or inappropriate touching of sensitive areas (such as the face, chest, or hips).
guides.item4_content: The purpose of attending the event is to enjoy dancing. Any form of "teaching" on the dance floor is strictly prohibited.
guides.warning: Violations of the above rules, if not corrected after a warning and deemed severe, will result in the termination of dance party privileges, a request to leave the venue, and notification to other dance party organizers in Taiwan. If you encounter harassment or inappropriate behavior on the dance floor, please report it directly to the organizers or on-site staff. Additionally, please pay attention to your friends, watch out for suspicious individuals, and take care of your personal belongings.

about.title: About
about.description: About the start of this website
about.content:
Hi, I’m Steve, a newbie who just joined the dance scene in September 2023🐔.
Back in January 2025, I was chatting with Eric Chen about if there's a  better way for newcomers to learn about the social dance scene — the culture, common issues, and how to handle them (since social dancing naturally comes with its own set of challenges 🙂). That’s when the idea for this website started.
As I was working on it, I realized that finding event info has always been a pain...so why not include that too? And before I knew it, the site turned into what it is now.
I hope this guide helps the Latin social dance community in Taiwan grow. If you have any feedback, feel free to let me know, I really appreciate it! And if you’d like to support me, you can also donate me to help cover the hosting costs 🥹. Thanks in advance!
